bib.title: ULTRAFEEDBACK: Boosting Language Models with Scaled AI Feedback

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed; case-study tables 10-13 read only in part

question: Can scaled, diversified GPT-4 feedback replace human preference data to align open-source chat models?
hypothesis: Scale and diversity of instructions and responses, plus debiased annotation, make AI feedback a reliable scalable alternative to human feedback.
contributions: First demonstration of the beneficial effect of scaled AI feedback on open-source chat LLMs
A systematic, sizable pipeline for high-quality diverse AI feedback
Release of a dataset, reward model (UltraRM) and critique model (UltraCM)

method.summary: Builds a 64k-instruction, 17-model, GPT-4-annotated preference and critique dataset using aspect decomposition, score rubrics, joint scoring of four completions and rationales. Trains UltraRM and UltraCM on LLaMA2-13B, then tests best-of-n and PPO on UltraLM-13B.
method.task: AI-feedback preference data construction; reward modeling; best-of-n; PPO

datasets.name: Instruction pool
datasets.source: TruthfulQA and FalseQA train (all); 10k Evol-Instruct; 10k UltraChat; 20k ShareGPT; FLAN stratified (3k from CoT subset, 10 per task for other three subsets, overly long dropped)
datasets.preprocessing: 13-gram decontamination vs AlpacaEval, Evol-Instruct, UltraChat test sets; 48 removed

datasets.name: UltraFeedback
datasets.source: GPT-4 annotation of 4 completions per instruction
datasets.preprocessing: Fine-grained score per aspect averaged for reward; overall critique score used for Overall variant

datasets.name: Stanford SHP
datasets.preprocessing: score ratio >2 only, at most 5 pairs per post

datasets.name: WebGPT, Summarize, HH, SHP preference test sets
datasets.split: WebGPT has no splits and was not trained on

other.use: annotator and evaluation judge; Claude-3 Sonnet as second judge

other.members: GPT-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, Bard, UltraLM-13B/65B, WizardLM-7B/13B/70B, Vicuna-33B, LLaMA2-7B/13B/70B-Chat, Alpaca-7B, MPT-30B-Chat, Falcon-40B-Instruct, StarChat, Pythia-12B

training.objective: Reward: binary ranking loss -log sigma(r(x,yc)-r(x,yr)-m(r)), m = absolute annotated score gap normalised to (0,1], 0 for ranking-only data. UltraCM: supervised critique generation. PPO on UltraRM reward.
training.batch_size: UltraRM 512 pairs (1024 completions); UltraCM 256; PPO mini-batch 64

other.reward_recipe: loss and hyperparameters follow Touvron et al. 2023b
other.ppo_other_settings: KL coefficient, clip, value model not stated

inference.samples: best-of-{1,2,4,8,16} on AlpacaEval; single run otherwise
inference.prompting: random principle (one hand-written per aspect plus ten GPT-4-curated) added to system prompt for completions

parameters.annotation: 4 completions scored jointly per GPT-4 call, 1-5 per aspect with rubric and rationale

metrics.name: Win rate
metrics.definition: GPT-4 judged win vs text-davinci-003 (AlpacaEval) or gpt-3.5-turbo (others)

metrics.name: Agreement
metrics.definition: GPT-4 vs human win/tie/lose labels, ties included

eval.protocol: Single runs, no seeds or significance tests; 3 human annotators (students) on 400 pairs; Claude-3 Sonnet second judge

availability.data: UltraFeedback released (stated); URLs not in text

prompts.text: The assistant should answer truthfully and be faithful to factual knowledge as well as given contexts, never making up any new facts that aren't true or cannot be grounded in the instruction.

prompts.purpose: Instruction-following rubric header for GPT-4 annotation
prompts.text: **Instruction Following Assessment** Evaluate alignment between output and intent. Assess understanding of task goals and restrictions. Scoring: Rate outputs 1 to 5: 1 Irrelevant, 2 Partial Focus, 3 Partial Compliance, 4 Almost There, 5 Comprehensive Compliance.
Please act as a teacher and provide specific and constructive feedback ... Finally, score the overall quality of the answer from 1 to 10, where 1 is the worst and 10 is the best.

limits: Assumes GPT-4 imitates human annotators; GPT-4-human agreement is only 59.7% (68.6% vs majority), near the level of human-human agreement
Decontamination only against three test sets (AlpacaEval, Evol-Instruct, UltraChat); users should decontaminate for their own evals
Weak on math and code; no safety-oriented conversations added
Evaluation relies on GPT-4 as judge, which underrates reasoning

Annotation biases (position, length, style) acknowledged in impact statement
